name: Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd.
summary: Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the designs, manufactures, installs, and sells various plant and environmental equipment and various individual machines in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company provides city gas and petroleum-related plants, chemical industrial plants, hydrogen production equipment, and sewage treatment equipment; and water treatment equipment, industrial wastewater treatment equipment, and FRP products. It also offers oil purifiers, marine environmental regulation compliance equipment; separators, filters, seawater intake debris removers; and agitators.
